## Overview

We extend regression to multiple predictors — both numerical and categorical — and explore interaction effects. We also get a first look at logistic regression for predicting categorical outcomes.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `11-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [11-content.zip](/files/projects/11-content.zip)
